audioDescription: Silent preview: no audio track, music, voiceover or sound effects.
limitations: Tissue paper is a procedural 2D approximation: translucency is source-over alpha compositing (layer globalAlpha 0.55 x per-piece foreground tint), not physical light transmission or scattering.
Torn edges are seeded value-noise perturbations of authored polygons, cached once as Path2D; no physical tearing or fibre-pull simulation.
Fibre texture is a seeded offscreen speckle and short-stroke canvas multiplied into each piece; it only darkens (no lighter fibre highlights) and does not respond to light direction.

No approved tissue hue tokens were supplied, so all tissue colours are alpha tints of #F2EEE1 on #172D3A, and fibre greys are chroma.mix blends of those two tokens. The scene is monochrome blue-grey, not multicoloured tissue.
Paper folding and curl (procedural_paper_curl) are not implemented; pieces are flat sheets that slide, rotate and scale into place.
Canvas is a fixed 1280x720 backing store with no devicePixelRatio upscaling.

Copy is HTML text in system fonts (Avenir Next / Helvetica Neue fallback), so exact rendering depends on the host's fonts. Token contrast is 12.28:1; the subtitle at 0.82 opacity is estimated at about 5.9:1 over the tinted band and has not been measured in rendered frames.
Not rendered or browser-tested by the agent; host QA pending.
